title: The AI Sales Agent Can Now Guide a Buyer Into Checkout
summary: For dealers with the Transaction Engine, the AI Sales Agent can now hand a buyer straight into online checkout mid-conversation, instead of only answering questions about buying online. Turn it on or off from Capabilities in Admin Portal.
body_markdown:
AI summary


For dealers with the Transaction Engine, the AI Sales Agent can now hand a buyer straight into online checkout mid-conversation, instead of only answering questions about buying online. Turn it on or off from Capabilities in Admin Portal.


A buyer asks the AI Sales Agent a question, gets a good answer, and then asks the obvious next one: can I just buy this online? Until now, the honest answer was always some version of "let me connect you with the team," even at a dealership where the buyer could, in fact, buy online.


For dealers with the Transaction Engine, that gap is closed.


##


What changed


The AI Sales Agent can now guide a buyer straight into checkout during the conversation. When a buyer signals they want to move forward, the agent hands them into checkout on the spot instead of only describing that the option exists.


The agent gets the buyer to checkout. It does not sign for them: financing decisions, contract signing, and payment still run through the same checkout flow every buyer goes through once they get there.


##


Where to find it


Open Admin Portal, then Capabilities. Dealers with the Transaction Engine can turn online checkout on or off for their AI Sales Agent from there.


## Frequently asked questions
